title: Construction Trucks for Kids! 5 Big Diggers with Bolt
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Bolt the little tow truck, and welcome to Tiny Truck Town!
Today we're visiting the construction site to meet five hard-working trucks.
Can you count them with me? One, two, three, four, five!

lines: Here's our first truck. Here's a clue: it has a long arm with a bucket for digging! Can you guess?
An excavator digs big holes with its bucket.
It rolls on tracks, so it won't get stuck in mud.
Can you scoop like a digger bucket? Scoop, scoop!
Can you guess? Can an excavator turn all the way around?
Yes! Its cab sits on a turntable, so it can spin all the way around.
Excavators help dig the start of new buildings.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it has a giant flat blade in front! Can you guess?
A bulldozer pushes dirt with its big blade.
Its tracks help it roll over bumpy ground.
Can you push with your hands like a bulldozer blade? Push!
Can you guess why bulldozers push dirt around?
To make the ground flat and smooth, so builders can build!
Bulldozers are super strong and steady.
Who's next? Here's a clue: its back tips up to pour out dirt and rocks! Can you guess?
A dump truck carries dirt, sand and rocks.
It has a big open box in the back called a bed.
Can you tip your body like a dump truck? Whoosh!
Can you guess how the rocks get out?
The bed tips up, and everything slides right out!
Let's say it together: DUMP TRUCK!
Dump trucks bring dirt to and from the building site.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it has a big spinning drum! Can you guess?
A cement mixer carries wet concrete.
The concrete slides out of a chute, like a slide!
Can you spin around like a mixer drum? Round and round!
Can you guess why the drum keeps spinning?
Spinning keeps the concrete mixed, so it doesn't get hard too soon.
Let's say it together: CEMENT MIXER!
Concrete dries hard to make sidewalks and roads.
Who's last? Here's a clue: it lifts heavy things way up high! Can you guess?
A crane has a very long arm called a boom.
A strong cable with a hook hangs down from the end.
Can you stretch your arm up high like a crane?
Can you guess what a crane lifts?
Heavy things, like big beams for buildings!
Cranes help build tall buildings, one piece at a time.

recap: What a busy construction site! Let's remember.
The excavator can spin all the way around.
The bulldozer makes the ground flat.
The dump truck tips up to pour.
And the crane lifts heavy beams!
outro: Which digger was your favorite? Be kind, and wave hello to the trucks you see.
Bye, friends! See you in Tiny Truck Town!
